historical_overlap.method: NFKC/casefold word trigrams of state, falling back to question; numeric_masked replaces all-digit tokens only; no semantic deduplication guarantee
historical_overlap.qualification: Word normalization removes meaningful code symbols/case. Such collisions are lexical flags, NOT exact duplicates or conflicting labels. Exact checks preserve those characters. Historical comparison includes tiny rows, not just v2.

limitations: Exploratory reference-label diagnostics, not independent accuracy or causal evidence of model shortcuts
Singleton source IDs and separately authored policies do not establish statistical independence
Heuristic negative findings cannot prove absence of semantic validation derivatives
Rule mechanisms remain split-disjoint; no seen-mechanism validation claim
